en: A colorized historic street scene showing a broad cobblestone square with tram tracks and several yellow and red electric trams. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square and along sidewalks. Surrounding the square are ornate multi‑story buildings with shops at ground level, striped awnings, and decorative facades. Trees and a few lampposts line the right side. The top of the image is captioned with the location name.
